subject: english-literature
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel International GCSE IGCSE English Literature specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Analysis of character, theme and structure in drama transfers to the study of prose narrative
The close-reading techniques drilled on the named anthology poems are exactly what students apply, unsupported, to unseen poetry
Sensitivity to a writer's language built on prose deepens the analysis of figurative language in the anthology
Attention to voice and dramatic tension informs the reading of speaker and tone in anthology poems
Independent close reading practised on prose strengthens the analytical instinct needed for unseen poems
